_readme: Cuti bersama (joint/collective leave) is set entirely at the government's discretion each year via SKB 3 Menteri - it is NOT derivable from any calendar rule, only from the official decree (usually published 3-4 months before the year starts). Add new years here once announced; there is no way to auto-generate them reliably.
